title: Battlegrounds
content: Battlegrounds are instanced PvP areas where teams compete for objectives. Warsong Gulch (capture the flag), Arathi Basin (resource control), Alterac Valley (massive battle with multiple objectives). Players earn honor points for victories and can purchase PvP gear. Battlegrounds require teamwork and strategy. Winning battlegrounds provides marks of honor used for epic gear.

title: Duels and the Gurubashi Arena
content: Vanilla has no Burning Crusade-style rated 2v2, 3v3, or 5v5 arena system. Players can practice through consensual duels, organized community tournaments, and the free-for-all Gurubashi Arena in Stranglethorn Vale. The Gurubashi chest event attracts opportunistic fighters and groups, while duels end before death. Neither activity awards arena points or rated arena gear.

title: World PvP
content: World PvP occurs wherever opposing flagged players meet. Common Vanilla flashpoints include Southshore and Tarren Mill, Stranglethorn Vale, Blackrock Mountain, the Plaguelands, Silithus, and the Gurubashi Arena. Terrain, graveyards, reinforcements, guards, and escape routes matter. PvE-server players generally need to flag or enter a PvP area, while PvP-server rules make contested zones more dangerous.

title: PvP Ranks and Titles
content: Players earn ranks through PvP victories, from 1 to 14. Higher ranks provide better gear and titles like 'Sergeant', 'Knight-Captain', 'Grand Marshal' (Alliance) or 'Grunt', 'Blood Guard', 'High Warlord' (Horde). Rank 14 requires extensive grinding. Titles are prestigious and show PvP dedication. Some ranks unlock special mounts or items.

title: PvP Gear Progression
content: Vanilla PvP gear comes from faction rank requirements, battleground reputations, marks, and honor-system vendors. Rank gear and weapons require sustained weekly standing, while battleground factions offer rewards at increasing reputation. There are no arena points, Resilience, or PvP Power stats. Strong PvE items may be mixed with PvP rewards when their damage, healing, stamina, or utility better fits the build.

title: Faction Conflicts
content: Alliance and Horde rivalry drives battlegrounds and contested-zone fighting. Warsong Gulch reflects the Warsong-Outrider and Silverwing-Sentinel struggle in Ashenvale; Arathi Basin centers on resource control; Alterac Valley pits the Frostwolf clan against the Stormpike Guard. Local conflicts and Turtle WoW custom zones can also create world-PvP flashpoints without using later expansion campaigns.

title: PvP Strategies and Tactics
content: Successful PvP requires different strategies than PvE. Focus on crowd control, burst damage, and survivability. Know class matchups and counters. Use terrain and positioning. Coordinate with team members. PvP often involves trading cooldowns and managing resources. Adapting to different situations is key to victory.

title: Honor System
content: The Vanilla honor system records honorable kills and battleground contribution, compares weekly honor against other players of the same faction, and updates rank progress during the weekly calculation. Repeatedly killing the same target gives diminishing value, while dishonorable kills can damage progress. Rank can decay without sustained participation; there are no rated seasons or arena points. Rank and battleground reputation unlock vendor rewards.

title: Ganking and Ambush Tactics
content: Ganking involves high-level players attacking lower-level players. This controversial tactic is common in world PvP. Players use stealth, speed, and surprise to ambush enemies. Ganking can be frustrating but is part of the PvP experience. Some areas are notorious for ganking. Players learn to be aware and prepared.

title: Battleground Objectives
content: Each Vanilla battleground has distinct objectives. Warsong Gulch requires capturing the enemy flag while protecting one's own. Arathi Basin rewards holding resource nodes until a team reaches the resource goal. Alterac Valley combines towers, graveyards, commanders, turn-ins, and the opposing general. Fighting away from objectives can waste time even when it produces honorable kills.

title: Team Composition
content: A strong battleground team mixes healing, durable flag or objective defenders, mobile damage, ranged pressure, crowd control, dispels, and utility. Class roles change by map: a druid may carry flags, a warrior may lead a focused push, and stealth classes may assault remote nodes. Vanilla has no rated arena-composition system, but class synergy, target calls, and communication remain decisive.

title: PvP vs PvE Gear
content: Vanilla PvP gear often emphasizes stamina, broad offensive stats, and useful set bonuses, but it has no Resilience or PvP Power. PvE raid gear can deliver stronger damage or healing while sacrificing survivability or accessibility. Build around the character's job, expected opponents, spell hit, weapon skill, resistances, and available consumables rather than assuming every item labeled as a PvP reward is automatically superior.

title: PvP Psychology and Mindset
content: PvP requires mental toughness and adaptability. Dealing with losses, managing tilt, staying focused. Understanding opponent psychology. Using mind games and deception. PvP is as much mental as physical. Developing the right mindset leads to better performance. Learning from defeats is crucial for improvement.

title: PvP Community and Culture
content: PvP has a strong community with rivalries, friendships, and traditions. Top players become celebrities. PvP guilds focus on competition. Community events and tournaments. Toxic behavior exists but good sportsmanship is valued. PvP community creates lasting bonds and memorable experiences. Being part of PvP community enhances enjoyment.

title: PvP Rewards and Incentives
content: Vanilla PvP rewards include faction rank titles, rank armor and weapons, high-rank mounts, battleground marks, reputation equipment, recipes, consumables, and tabards. The most prestigious rewards demand sustained weekly competition or high battleground reputation. There are no achievement-point or seasonal arena rewards. Turtle WoW may add custom PvP rewards, which follow the server's current vendor requirements.
